label: VPN Block
description: Blocks connections from known VPN/datacentre IP ranges.

commands.name: vpn
commands.description: Checks whether the specified player is playing from a known VPN/datacentre IP.

commands.name: bypassvpn
commands.description: Allows the specified player to connect while using a VPN, bypassing the block.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Turns VPN/datacentre IP blocking on or off.

cvars.label: IP List Refresh (hours)
cvars.description: How often the known VPN/datacentre IP range list is refreshed.
